description: Figure 1 is a line plot illustrating the similarity of HSAs between different language pairs across the transformer layers of the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis represents layer index (labeled by layer number), shown on a linear scale spanning the full set of model layers (from the first layer at the left to the last layer at the right) with evenly spaced integer tick marks. The y-axis represents similarity (cosine similarity) on a linear scale, with values ranging from low to high similarity (exact numeric tick labels are not legible in the provided image). Multiple colored lines are plotted, each corresponding to a different language pair; each line is drawn as a continuous curve (individual marker shapes are not discernible at this resolution). Across the x-axis, the lines vary by layer, with one line (described in the surrounding text as the red line) remaining relatively higher across layers, while the other lines follow similar trajectories with visible rises and dips across early, middle, and later layers; precise point values at specific layers cannot be read from the provided image.
